title: 77 Sign & Go Wedding at Hawaiian Wedding Chapel
includes: Photo Shoot in the Chapel of the couple
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Booking is for two people only, marrying each other.

You must bring a Nevada Marriage License to the Chapel at the time of your Reservation. Marriage License Information: The cost of the Nevada Marriage License is $102.00. There is no blood test or waiting period. Documents such as divorce decrees, death certificates or birth certificates are not required in Nevada. You will need a passport or a driver's license for identification. The Clark County Marriage License Bureau is open daily from 8am to midnight (12am). It is located at 201 E. Clark Ave, Downtown Las Vegas. The Minister will file your Marriage License for you at the Clark County Recorder's Office to ensure legal recognition.
This Booking is not appropriate for guests but you may bring your own witness.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Simple and quick Sign and Go wedding with a photo shoot in our Hawaiian Themed Wedding Chapel. Our beautiful chapel and setting is the perfect place for your Las Vegas Wedding!
